description:
Generate images, video, speech, music and sound effects — and transcribe speech — via the IMG.LY AI gateway.

Call with NO arguments first: returns the curated model catalog, every entry tagged with its `capability` (text2image, image2image, text2video, image2video, text2speech, speech2text, …). Filter with `capability`; `source: "all"` (together with a `capability`) adds the provider models (`@falai/…` ids — e.g. music and sound effects under `text2audio`). Before calling a model, read `skill://codesign/models/SKILL.md`: how to prompt each model and what its result looks like.

Then call with `model` + `prompt` (+ optional `format` aspect like "16:9"). Model-specific inputs (duration, voice, lyrics, an input file…) go in `params`, sent to the model verbatim under the model's own field names — `model` + `schema: true` returns the fields a model takes. Any `workspace://` URI inside `params` is uploaded for the model first (e.g. `{ audio_url: "workspace://assets/…mp3" }` to transcribe).

For image-to-image, pass `image_uris` with `workspace://` URIs (from `import` or earlier generations).

The first content part is JSON: `{ uri, httpUrl, mimeType, kind, bytes, duration? }`. `uri` (a `workspace://` URI) is the durable handle — embed it in subsequent `edit` calls (image or video fill, audio block). `httpUrl` opens the asset directly. `duration` (seconds) is present for audio/video when the file header states it. For images the parts after it are a labeled thumbnail of each generated image — look at them; the JSON alone does not tell you what was drawn. A result that is data rather than a file (a speech2text transcript with word timings) comes back as `{ output }`, verbatim.

Multi-output models (layerize-class: decompose an input image into layers) add an `assets` array to that JSON — one entry per image, `{ index, uri, httpUrl, mimeType, bytes }`, in stack order (residual background first, then cutout layers). The top-level fields mirror `assets[0]`. Single-output results carry no `assets` array. Any non-image output the model produced is passed through VERBATIM under `metadata` — read it, it binds semantics to the assets (layerize, for example, ships a layers list in `assets` order with names, z order and bounding boxes in source pixels; cutouts are cropped to content, so place them by their bounding box).

Requires a free IMG.LY sign-in (the `login` tool); all other design tools work without an account.

image_uris.description: workspace:// image URIs used as inputs (image-to-image models).

model.description: Model id from the catalog (call with no arguments to list). Required to generate or to read a schema.

params.description: Model-specific inputs sent verbatim (e.g. { "voice": "Aria" }, { "duration": 8 }). workspace:// URIs inside are uploaded first.

prompt.description: What to generate. Required with `model` unless the model takes its input through `params`.

schema.description: With `model`: return that model's input schema instead of generating.

source.description: Catalog source: "catalog" (default, curated) or "all" (adds the provider models; needs `capability`).

name: asset_generate
